scripts.agent:install: cp com.research-fetcher.agent.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.research-fetcher.agent.plist && echo 'Agent installed and started'
scripts.agent:status: launchctl list | grep research-fetcher || echo 'not loaded'
scripts.web:install: cp com.research-fetcher.web.plist ~/Library/LaunchAgents/ && launchctl load ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.research-fetcher.web.plist && echo 'Web service installed and started at http://localhost:3737'
scripts.web:uninstall: launchctl unload ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.research-fetcher.web.plist && rm ~/Library/LaunchAgents/com.research-fetcher.web.plist && echo 'Web service removed'
scripts.install:all: npm run agent:install && npm run web:install
scripts.status: launchctl list | grep research-fetcher || echo 'no research-fetcher services loaded'
